claims.statement: Ifrit is a kind of jinn mentioned in the Quran.
claims.statement_id: Ifrit adalah jenis jin yang disebut dalam Al-Qur’an.
claims.quote: adalah sejenis jin yang disebut dalam al-Qur'an.

claims.statement: The article connects Ifrit with An-Naml 27:39–40.
claims.statement_id: Artikel menghubungkan Ifrit dengan An-Naml 27:39–40.
claims.quote: Jin Ifrit disebutkan dalam surah An-Naml [27]:39-40:

claims.statement: In the quoted commentary, Ifrit offers to bring the throne before Solomon rises.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tafsir yang dikutip, Ifrit menawarkan membawa singgasana sebelum Sulaiman berdiri.
claims.quote: Aku akan datang kepadamu dengan membawa singgasana itu sebelum kamu berdiri dari tempat dudukmu

claims.statement: In that commentary, Ifrit asserts his strength.
claims.statement_id: Ifrit dalam tafsir itu menyatakan dirinya kuat.
claims.quote: dan sesungguhnya aku benar-benar kuat

claims.statement: In that commentary, Solomon asks for something faster.
claims.statement_id: Sulaiman dalam tafsir itu meminta cara yang lebih cepat.
claims.quote: Maka Nabi Sulaiman berkata, "Aku menginginkan yang lebih cepat dari itu".

claims.statement: The same commentary distinguishes the honest Ashif ibn Barkhiya, who offers another method, from Ifrit.
claims.statement_id: Tafsir yang sama membedakan Ashif ibn Barkhiya, sosok jujur yang kemudian menawarkan cara lain, dari Ifrit.
claims.quote: ia bernama Ashif ibnu Barkhiya; dia terkenal sangat jujur

claims.statement: An-Naml 27:39 describes an afreet among the jinn offering to bring it before the listener rises, asserting power and trustworthiness.
claims.statement_id: Terjemahan An-Naml 27:39 menyebut afreet dari golongan jin menawarkan membawa benda itu sebelum pendengarnya bangkit, serta menyatakan kekuatan dan kepercayaannya.
claims.quote: An afreet from among the jinn said, ‘I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. I have the power to do it and am trustworthy.’

claims.statement: Zahhak personifies evil in Iranian mythology and historiography.
claims.statement_id: Zahhak adalah personifikasi kejahatan dalam mitologi dan penulisan sejarah Iran.
claims.quote: is a personification of evil in Iranian mythology and historiography.

claims.statement: Avestan and Zoroastrian traditions identify Azhi Dahaka as Ahriman’s son.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi Avesta dan Zoroastrian menyebut Azhi Dahaka sebagai putra Ahriman.
claims.quote: Zahāk (going under the name Aži Dahāka) is considered the son of Ahriman

claims.statement: In the Shahnameh, Zahhak is the son of the Arab ruler Merdas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Shahnameh, Zahhak adalah putra penguasa Arab Merdas.
claims.quote: In the Shāhnāmeh of Ferdowsi, Zahāk is the son of an Arab ruler named Merdās.

claims.statement: Avestan azi means serpent or dragon.
claims.statement_id: Azi dalam bahasa Avesta berarti ular atau naga.
claims.quote: Aži (nominative ažiš) is the Avestan word for "serpent" or "dragon".

claims.statement: The original meaning of dahaka remains uncertain.
claims.statement_id: Arti asli dahaka tidak pasti.
claims.quote: The original meaning of dahāka is uncertain.

claims.statement: In the accompanying account, Zahak overthrows Jamshid and establishes a thousand-year tyranny.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian sumber pendamping, Zahak menggulingkan Jamshid dan mendirikan tirani selama seribu tahun.
claims.quote: He then overthrew the king Jamshid and established a tyranny over the world which lasted 1,000 years.

claims.statement: Fereydun then overthrows Zahak and restores order and justice.
claims.statement_id: Zahak kemudian digulingkan Fereydun yang memulihkan ketertiban dan keadilan.
claims.quote: He was overthrown by the hero Fereydun who restored order and justice.

claims.statement: Ziusudra of Shuruppak is listed as the last pre-flood king in the WB-62 Sumerian King List.
claims.statement_id: Ziusudra dari Shuruppak tercatat sebagai raja terakhir sebelum Air Bah dalam versi WB-62 Daftar Raja Sumeria.
claims.quote: of Shuruppak is listed in the WB-62 Sumerian King List recension as the last king of Sumer prior to the Great Flood.

claims.statement: Ziusudra appears as the hero of the Eridu Genesis.
claims.statement_id: Ziusudra tampil sebagai pahlawan dalam Eridu Genesis.
claims.quote: He is subsequently recorded as the hero of the Eridu Genesis

claims.statement: The Sumerian flood text describes the great boat being buffeted for seven days and nights.
claims.statement_id: Teks Banjir Sumeria mengisahkan perahu besar diguncang gelombang selama tujuh hari dan malam.
claims.quote: waves and windstorms had rocked the huge boat for seven days and seven nights

claims.statement: King Ziusudra prostrates himself before Utu after the flood.
claims.statement_id: Raja Ziusudra bersujud kepada Utu setelah banjir.
claims.quote: Zi-ud-sura the king prostrated himself before Utu.

claims.statement: An and Enlil grant Ziusudra godlike and eternal life.
claims.statement_id: An dan Enlil memberikan kehidupan seperti dewa serta hidup abadi kepada Ziusudra.
claims.quote: they granted him life like a god, they brought down to him eternal life.

claims.statement: The gods settle Ziusudra in Dilmun, where the sun rises.
claims.statement_id: Para dewa menempatkan Ziusudra di Dilmun, negeri tempat matahari terbit.
claims.quote: they settled Zi-ud-sura the king in an overseas country, in the land Dilmun, where the sun rises.

claims.statement: Mushussu is a creature of ancient Mesopotamian mythology.
claims.statement_id: Mushussu adalah makhluk mitologi Mesopotamia kuno.
claims.quote: is a creature from ancient Mesopotamian mythology.

claims.statement: Its body combines eagle-like hind talons, lion-like forelimbs, and a long neck and tail.
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya menggabungkan kaki belakang bercakar elang, kaki depan mirip singa, dan leher serta ekor panjang.
claims.quote: hind legs resembling the talons of an eagle, lion-like forelimbs, a long neck and tail

claims.statement: Mushussu appears on Babylon’s sixth-century BCE Ishtar Gate.
claims.statement_id: Mushussu muncul pada Gerbang Ishtar Babilonia abad keenam SM.
claims.quote: The mušḫuššu most famously appears on the Ishtar Gate of the city of Babylon, dating to the sixth century BCE.

claims.statement: Mushussu is the sacred animal of Marduk and Nabu.
claims.statement_id: Mushussu menjadi hewan suci Marduk dan Nabu.
claims.quote: The mušḫuššu was the sacred animal of Marduk and his son Nabu

claims.statement: Marduk takes over the creature’s association from Tishpak of Eshnunna.
claims.statement_id: Marduk mengambil kaitan hewan ini dari Tishpak, dewa Eshnunna.
claims.quote: It was taken over by Marduk from Tishpak, the local god of Eshnunna.

claims.statement: The accompanying source interprets Mushhushshu’s name as Furious Snake.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menerjemahkan nama Mushhushshu sebagai Ular Ganas.
claims.quote: whose name translates as `furious snake'.

claims.statement: Ninsun is a Mesopotamian goddess known as Gilgamesh’s mother.
claims.statement_id: Ninsun adalah dewi Mesopotamia yang dikenal sebagai ibu Gilgamesh.
claims.quote: was a Mesopotamian goddess. She is best known as the mother of the hero Gilgamesh

claims.statement: Ninsun is identified as the wife of the deified legendary king Lugalbanda.
claims.statement_id: Ninsun disebut sebagai istri raja legenda Lugalbanda yang didewakan.
claims.quote: wife of deified legendary king Lugalbanda

claims.statement: In the Standard Babylonian version, Ninsun advises Gilgamesh and interprets his dreams.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Babilonia standar, Ninsun menasihati Gilgamesh dan menafsirkan mimpinya.
claims.quote: she advises her son and interprets his dreams

claims.statement: Kings of the Third Dynasty of Ur regard Ninsun as their divine mother.
claims.statement_id: Raja Dinasti Ketiga Ur menganggap Ninsun sebagai ibu ilahi mereka.
claims.quote: Kings from the Third Dynasty of Ur regarded Ninsun as their divine mother

claims.statement: Ninsun’s name is written dNIN.GUL in cuneiform.
claims.statement_id: Nama Ninsun ditulis sebagai dNIN.GUL dalam aksara paku.
claims.quote: Ninsun's name was written dNIN.GUL.

claims.statement: Ninsun is described as wise and skilled in interpreting dreams.
claims.statement_id: Ninsun digambarkan sangat bijaksana dan mahir menafsirkan mimpi.
claims.quote: She was adept at interpreting dreams and was very wise.

claims.statement: Pazuzu is a demonic deity of Babylonian and Assyrian cultures in the first millennium BCE.
claims.statement_id: Pazuzu adalah sosok ilahi iblis Babilonia dan Asyur pada milenium pertama SM.
claims.quote: is a demonic deity from the Babylonian and Assyrian cultures in the first millennium BCE.

claims.statement: Hanbi is believed to be Pazuzu’s father.
claims.statement_id: Hanbi dipercaya sebagai ayah Pazuzu.
claims.quote: He was believed to be the son of the god Hanbi.

claims.statement: Pazuzu amulets are placed in dwellings to protect infants from Lamashtu.
claims.statement_id: Jimat bergambar Pazuzu ditempatkan di rumah untuk melindungi bayi dari Lamashtu.
claims.quote: Amulets bearing his image were positioned in dwellings to protect infants from Lamashtu

claims.statement: Pregnant women wear Pazuzu-head amulets for protection from Lamashtu.
claims.statement_id: Perempuan hamil memakai jimat berkepala Pazuzu untuk perlindungan dari Lamashtu.
claims.quote: pregnant women frequently wore amulets with his head on them as protection from her.

claims.statement: One aspect of Pazuzu is a wandering wind demon crossing mountains.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu aspek Pazuzu adalah iblis angin pengembara yang melintasi pegunungan.
claims.quote: the wandering wind demon traversing the mountains

claims.statement: Pazuzu is known for destructive powers.
claims.statement_id: Pazuzu dikenal memiliki kekuatan merusak.
claims.quote: He was famous for his destructive powers

claims.statement: Nammu is a creator goddess in Eridu’s local theology.
claims.statement_id: Nammu adalah dewi pencipta dalam teologi lokal Eridu.
claims.quote: was a Mesopotamian goddess regarded as a creator deity in the local theology of Eridu.

claims.statement: Nammu is associated with incantations and protective magic.
claims.statement_id: Nammu dikaitkan dengan mantra dan sihir penolak bahaya.
claims.quote: She is also well attested in connection with incantations and apotropaic magic.

claims.statement: Nammu is regarded as Enki’s mother.
claims.statement_id: Nammu dianggap sebagai ibu Enki.
claims.quote: She was regarded as the mother of Enki

claims.statement: Nammu has a temple at Ur in the Old Babylonian period.
claims.statement_id: Nammu memiliki kuil di Ur pada masa Babilonia Lama.
claims.quote: A temple dedicated to her existed in Ur in the Old Babylonian period

claims.statement: In Enki and Ninmah, Nammu takes part in creating humanity.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Enki dan Ninmah, Nammu ikut berperan dalam penciptaan manusia.
claims.quote: Nammu is one of the deities involved in the creation of mankind

claims.statement: The accompanying source also identifies Enki as the goddess Nammu’s son.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping juga menyebut Enki sebagai putra dewi Nammu.
claims.quote: He is also referred to as the son of the goddess Nammu

claims.statement: Melek Taus, the Peacock Angel, is an important angel in Yazidi belief.
claims.statement_id: Melek Taus atau Malaikat Merak adalah malaikat penting dalam kepercayaan Yazidi.
claims.quote: berarti Malaikat Merak, adalah malaikat penting dalam kepercayaan orang Yazidi.

claims.statement: The Yazidi creation account appoints seven holy angels to guard the world.
claims.statement_id: Kisah penciptaan Yazidi menyebut tujuh malaikat suci ditugaskan menjaga dunia.
claims.quote: Tuhan menciptakan dunia dan menugaskan tujuh malaikat suci

claims.statement: Tawuse Melek is identified as one of the most important angels.
claims.statement_id: Tawuse Melek disebut sebagai salah satu malaikat terpenting.
claims.quote: Salah satu yang terpenting adalah Tawûsê Melek.

claims.statement: The article distinguishes the early twentieth-century Book of Revelation by non-Yazidi writers from its underlying oral traditions.
claims.statement_id: Artikel membedakan Kitab Wahyu tertulis awal abad kedua puluh oleh penulis non-Yazidi dari tradisi lisan yang mendasarinya.
claims.quote: ditulis oleh orang non-Yazidi pada awal abad ke-20 tetapi didasarkan pada tradisi lisan Yazidi

claims.statement: Yazidis honor Tawuse Melek’s refusal to bow and do not interpret it as pride.
claims.statement_id: Yazidi menghormati penolakan sujud Tawuse Melek dan tidak menafsirkannya sebagai kesombongan.
claims.quote: Yazidi menghormati Tawûsê Melek karena hal tersebut dianggap bukan melambangkan kesombongan

claims.statement: The refusal is interpreted as independence in passing a divine test.
claims.statement_id: Penolakan itu ditafsirkan sebagai kemandirian ketika melewati ujian Tuhan.
claims.quote: menunjukkan independensinya dalam melewati salah satu ujian dari Tuhan.

claims.statement: Joseph’s historical collection itself questions whether the Yezidis regard Melek Taus as an evil spirit.
claims.statement_id: Koleksi historis Joseph sendiri mencatat ketidakpastian anggapan bahwa orang Yazidi memandang Melek Taus sebagai roh jahat.
claims.quote: But it is not certain that the Yezidis believe in Melek Ṭâ´ûs as an evil spirit.

claims.statement: Atargatis is the chief goddess of northern Syria in classical antiquity.
claims.statement_id: Atargatis adalah dewi utama Suriah utara pada zaman klasik.
claims.quote: was the chief goddess of northern Syria in classical antiquity.

claims.statement: The Greeks call Atargatis Derceto.
claims.statement_id: Bangsa Yunani menyebut Atargatis sebagai Derceto.
claims.quote: (known as Derceto by the Greeks) was

claims.statement: Atargatis is primarily associated with fertility.
claims.statement_id: Atargatis terutama dihubungkan dengan kesuburan.
claims.quote: Primarily she was a fertility goddess

claims.statement: Atargatis’s chief sanctuary stands at Hierapolis, modern Manbij, near Aleppo.
claims.statement_id: Kuil utama Atargatis berada di Hierapolis, kini Manbij, dekat Aleppo.
claims.quote: Her chief sanctuary was at Hierapolis, modern Manbij, northeast of Aleppo, Syria.

claims.statement: Hadad is usually her consort; doves and fish are sacred to her.
claims.statement_id: Hadad biasanya menjadi pasangannya; merpati dan ikan dianggap suci baginya.
claims.quote: Her consort is usually Hadad. As Ataratheh, doves and fish were considered sacred to her

claims.statement: Some accounts depict Atargatis as a mermaid goddess.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian uraian menggambarkan Atargatis sebagai dewi putri duyung.
claims.quote: She is sometimes described as a mermaid-goddess

claims.statement: Mackenzie’s account reports Pliny identifying Derceto with Atargatis of Hierapolis.
claims.statement_id: Penceritaan Mackenzie menyebut Plinius mengidentifikasi Derceto dengan Atargatis dari Hierapolis.
claims.quote: Pliny identified that deity with Atargatis of Hierapolis.

claims.statement: Anzu is a divine sky creature depicted as a giant lion-headed bird.
claims.statement_id: Anzu adalah makhluk langit ilahi berupa burung raksasa berkepala singa.
claims.quote: ANZU - The divine sky creature depicted as a giant bird with the head of a lion

claims.statement: Anzu is also named Zu and Imdugud in Babylonian, Sumerian, and Akkadian tales.
claims.statement_id: Anzu juga disebut Zu dan Imdugud dalam kisah Babilonia, Sumeria, dan Akkadia.
claims.quote: also known as Zu and Imdugud, and featured in tales from the Babylonians, Sumerians and Akkadians.

claims.statement: Anzu appears in the Sumerian tale of the Huluppu Tree.
claims.statement_id: Anzu tampil dalam kisah Sumeria Pohon Huluppu.
claims.quote: The Anzu bird appears prominently in the Sumerian tale of The Huluppu Tree

claims.statement: Anzu is assigned to guard the Tablets of Destiny in one story.
claims.statement_id: Anzu ditugaskan menjaga Lauh Takdir dalam satu kisah.
claims.quote: he is charged with guarding the Tablets of Destiny

claims.statement: Ninurta retrieves the Tablets and kills Anzu in the summarized version.
claims.statement_id: Ninurta merebut kembali Lauh dan membunuh Anzu dalam versi yang diringkas.
claims.quote: The god Ninurta retrieves the Tablets and kills Anzu

claims.statement: Another version describes Anzu dying from Ninurta’s arrows.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut Anzu mati terkena panah Ninurta.
claims.quote: in another, it died through the arrows of the god Ninurta.

claims.statement: The Bull of Heaven, also called Gugalanna, is described as Ereshkigal’s consort.
claims.statement_id: Banteng Langit atau Gugalanna disebut sebagai pasangan Ereshkigal.
claims.quote: BULL OF HEAVEN - Also known as Gugalanna, the Bull of Heaven was consort to the Queen of the Underworld, Ereshkigal

claims.statement: The Bull of Heaven is under Anu’s control.
claims.statement_id: Banteng Langit berada di bawah kendali Anu.
claims.quote: was controlled by the Lord of the Sky, Anu.

claims.statement: After Gilgamesh rejects her, Ishtar demands the Bull of Heaven from Anu.
claims.statement_id: Setelah ditolak Gilgamesh, Ishtar meminta Anu melepaskan Banteng Langit.
claims.quote: Ishtar, spurned by Gilgamesh, demands that Anu release the Bull of Heaven

claims.statement: Gilgamesh and Enkidu kill the Bull of Heaven.
claims.statement_id: Gilgamesh dan Enkidu membunuh Banteng Langit.
claims.quote: The Bull of Heaven is killed by Gilgamesh and Enkidu

claims.statement: Killing the bull leads to the decree that Enkidu must die.
claims.statement_id: Pembunuhan banteng menghasilkan keputusan bahwa Enkidu harus mati.
claims.quote: it is decreed that Enkidu must die.

claims.statement: The accompanying source associates the cosmic Bull with Taurus.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menghubungkan Banteng Langit dengan rasi Taurus.
claims.quote: The cosmic Bull (associated with the constellation, Taurus)

claims.statement: Fravashi is a powerful supernatural being whose concept blends with the urvan in early Zoroastrianism.
claims.statement_id: Fravashi adalah makhluk gaib kuat yang konsepnya menyatu dengan urvan atau jiwa dalam Zoroastrianisme awal.
claims.quote: the Avestan word for a powerful supernatural being whose concept at an early stage in Zoroastrianism became blended with that of the urvan.

claims.statement: Fravashis are imagined as a vast host numbering hundreds, thousands, and tens of thousands.
claims.statement_id: Fravashi dibayangkan sebagai kumpulan sangat besar, berjumlah ratusan hingga puluhan ribu.
claims.quote: many hundreds, many thousands, many tens of thousands

claims.statement: Their Yasht depicts fravashis helping Ahura Mazda order the world and maintaining it.
claims.statement_id: Yasht menggambarkan fravashi membantu Ahura Mazda menata dunia.
claims.quote: in the beginning to order the world, and as powerful now in maintaining it

claims.statement: Fravashis are associated with nurturing waters and plants and protecting children in the womb.
claims.statement_id: Fravashi dihubungkan dengan pemeliharaan air, tumbuhan, dan perlindungan anak dalam kandungan.
claims.quote: in particular in nurturing waters and plants, and protecting sons in the womb

claims.statement: Fravashis strive to obtain water for their family, settlement, tribe, and country.
claims.statement_id: Fravashi berusaha memperoleh air bagi keluarga, permukiman, suku, dan negeri masing-masing.
claims.quote: they strive among themselves to obtain water for their own “family, settlement, tribe, and country”

claims.statement: The Mihr Yasht describes the faithful’s fravashis as granting virtuous offspring.
claims.statement_id: Mihr Yasht menyebut fravashi kaum beriman memberikan keturunan yang berbudi.
claims.quote: The good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful give a virtuous offspring

claims.statement: Kingu, or Qingu, is a Mesopotamian deity known from the Enuma Elish.
claims.statement_id: Kingu atau Qingu adalah dewa Mesopotamia yang dikenal dari Enuma Elish.
claims.quote: was a Mesopotamian god. He is best known from the Enūma Eliš

claims.statement: Qingu is Tiamat’s subordinate and spouse and Marduk’s adversary.
claims.statement_id: Qingu menjadi bawahan sekaligus pasangan Tiamat dan musuh Marduk.
claims.quote: he acts as a subordinate and spouse of Tiamat, and an adversary of Marduk.

claims.statement: After defeat, Qingu is killed and his blood is used to create humanity.
claims.statement_id: Setelah kalah, Qingu dibunuh dan darahnya dipakai menciptakan manusia.
claims.quote: After his defeat he is killed and his blood is used in the creation of mankind.

claims.statement: The spelling Qingu is more common and considered closer to the original pronunciation than Kingu.
claims.statement_id: Ejaan Qingu lebih umum dan dinilai lebih dekat pada pelafalan asli daripada Kingu.
claims.quote: Qingu is the most commonly used, and is presumed to be more accurate to the original pronunciation.

claims.statement: Qingu’s name is regarded as having a Sumerian origin.
claims.statement_id: Nama Qingu dipandang berasal dari bahasa Sumeria.
claims.quote: It is accepted that Qingu's name has Sumerian origin

claims.statement: Qingu is Tiamat’s champion in the war against younger gods.
claims.statement_id: Qingu menjadi jagoan Tiamat dalam perang melawan dewa muda.
claims.quote: the consort of Tiamat and her champion in her war with the younger gods.

claims.statement: Namtar can be regarded as a minor god or a disease demon.
claims.statement_id: Namtar dapat dipandang sebagai dewa kecil maupun iblis penyakit.
claims.quote: could be regarded both as a minor god and as a demon of disease.

claims.statement: Namtar is known as Ereshkigal’s attendant deity.
claims.statement_id: Namtar dikenal sebagai pembantu ilahi Ereshkigal.
claims.quote: He is best attested as the sukkal (attendant deity) of Ereshkigal

claims.statement: Namtar’s name means fate in Sumerian.
claims.statement_id: Nama Namtar berarti takdir dalam bahasa Sumeria.
claims.quote: Namtar's name means "fate" in Sumerian.

claims.statement: Namtar is particularly associated with headaches and heart pain.
claims.statement_id: Namtar terutama dihubungkan dengan sakit kepala dan nyeri jantung.
claims.quote: especially strongly associated with headaches and heart pain.

claims.statement: Namtar’s appearance is usually described as fearsome.
claims.statement_id: Penampilannya biasanya digambarkan mengerikan.
claims.quote: His appearance was typically described as fearsome

claims.statement: Namtar carries messages from the underworld to the gods’ upper realms.
claims.statement_id: Namtar membawa pesan dari dunia bawah ke alam atas para dewa.
claims.quote: He carries messages from the underworld to the upper realms of the gods.

claims.statement: Pari, or peri, is a supernatural being originating in Persian tales and spreading through Asian folklore.
claims.statement_id: Pari atau peri adalah makhluk gaib asal kisah Persia yang menyebar dalam cerita rakyat Asia.
claims.quote: is a supernatural entity originating from Persian tales and distributed into wider Asian folklore.

claims.statement: Paris are often depicted as winged beings of great beauty.
claims.statement_id: Pari sering digambarkan sebagai makhluk bersayap yang sangat indah.
claims.quote: The parīs are often described as winged creatures of immense beauty

claims.statement: Early Persian belief may treat paris as evil spirits before later positive depictions.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan Persia awal kemungkinan memperlakukan pari sebagai roh jahat sebelum gambaran positif berkembang.
claims.quote: the parīs were probably a class of evil spirits and only later received a positive reception.

claims.statement: Paris are often contrasted with their ugly div adversaries.
claims.statement_id: Pari sering dipertentangkan dengan musuhnya, div yang buruk rupa.
claims.quote: They are often contrasted by their nemeses, the ugly dīvs.

claims.statement: Paris are said to abduct people and take them to Paristan.
claims.statement_id: Pari dikatakan menculik manusia dan membawanya ke Paristan.
claims.quote: they are said to abduct people and take them to their home-world, Parīstān

claims.statement: The accompanying source describes peris as neutral in the war between Good and Evil.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menggambarkan peri sebagai pihak netral dalam perang Baik dan Jahat.
claims.quote: Peris, like jinns, are considered neutral in the war between Good and Evil

claims.statement: The huma is a mythical bird of Iranian legends and fables.
claims.statement_id: Huma adalah burung mitos dalam legenda dan fabel Iran.
claims.quote: is a mythical bird of Iranian legends and fables

claims.statement: The huma is a recurring motif in Sufi and Diwan poetry.
claims.statement_id: Huma menjadi motif yang sering muncul dalam puisi Sufi dan Diwan.
claims.quote: a common motif in Sufi and Diwan poetry.

claims.statement: The huma is believed never to alight on the ground.
claims.statement_id: Huma dipercaya tidak pernah hinggap di tanah.
claims.quote: the bird is said never to alight on the ground

claims.statement: Some accounts describe the huma consuming itself in fire and returning from ashes.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian versi menceritakan huma terbakar lalu bangkit dari abu.
claims.quote: consuming itself in fire every few hundred years, only to rise anew from the ashes.

claims.statement: The huma’s shadow or touch is considered auspicious.
claims.statement_id: Bayangan atau sentuhan huma dianggap membawa keberuntungan.
claims.quote: its shadow (or touch) is said to be auspicious.

claims.statement: Harming or attempting to harm the huma is believed to bring lifelong bad luck.

claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Guanche di Tenerife (Kepulauan Canary), Guayota adalah dewa jahat utama dan lawan Achamán.
claims.quote: Guayota, in Guanche mythology of Tenerife (the Canary Islands), was the principal malignant deity and Achamán's adversary.

claims.statement: According to Guanche legend, Guayota lived inside the Teide volcano, one of the gateways to the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda Guanche, Guayota tinggal di dalam gunung api Teide, salah satu gerbang menuju dunia bawah.
claims.quote: According to Guanche legend, Guayota lived inside the Teide volcano, one of the gateways to the underworld.

claims.statement: He was said to be represented as a black dog and was accompanied by demons, also in the form of black dogs, known as tibicenas.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan digambarkan sebagai anjing hitam dan ditemani iblis-iblis, juga berwujud anjing hitam, yang disebut tibicena.
claims.quote: He was said to be represented as a black dog and was accompanied by demons, also in the form of black dogs, known as tibicenas.

claims.statement: According to legend, Guayota kidnapped Magec (the sun) and shut it up in Teide, plunging the world into darkness; humans prayed to Achamán, who saved Magec and instead locked Guayota up in Teide.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Guayota menculik Magec (matahari) dan mengurungnya di Teide sehingga dunia gelap gulita; manusia berdoa kepada Achamán yang menyelamatkan Magec dan sebaliknya mengurung Guayota di Teide.
claims.quote: According to legend, Guayota kidnapped Magec (the sun) and shut it up in Teide, plunging the world into darkness. Humans prayed to Achamán who saved Magec and instead locked Guayota up in Teide.

claims.statement: Guayota shares features with other malignant deity-inhabitants of volcanoes, as in the case of the goddess Pele in Hawaiian mythology, who lived in the Kilauea volcano.
claims.statement_id: Guayota memiliki ciri serupa dengan penghuni gunung api lain yang jahat, seperti dewi Pele dalam mitologi Hawaii yang tinggal di gunung api Kilauea.
claims.quote: Guayota shares features similar to other malignant deity-inhabitants of volcanoes as in the case of the goddess Pele in Hawaiian mythology, who lived in the Kīlauea volcano

claims.statement: Guayota is the main antagonist in Night Broken by Patricia Briggs, the eighth novel in her Mercy Thompson series.
claims.statement_id: Guayota tampil sebagai antagonis utama dalam Night Broken karya Patricia Briggs, novel kedelapan dalam serial Mercy Thompson.
claims.quote: Guayota is featured as the main antagonist in Night Broken by Patricia Briggs, the eighth novel in her Mercy Thompson series.

claims.statement: In the indie video game Gaurodan, Guayota appears as the final boss.
claims.statement_id: Dalam gim video indie Gaurodan, Guayota muncul sebagai bos terakhir.
claims.quote: In the indie video game Gaurodan, Guayota appears as the final boss.

claims.statement: Echeyde is the name for the dwelling of the demon Guayota.
claims.statement_id: Echeyde adalah nama bagi tempat tinggal iblis Guayota.
claims.quote: Es ist der Name für die Wohnung des Dämons Guayota.

claims.statement: The name "el Teide" comes from the language of the Guanches, the island's original inhabitants, and was originally "Echeyde".
claims.statement_id: Nama "el Teide" berasal dari bahasa suku Guanche, penduduk asli pulau itu, dan semula berbunyi "Echeyde".
claims.quote: Der Name „el Teide“ kommt ursprünglich aus der Sprache der Guanchen, der Ureinwohner der Insel, und war ursprünglich „Echeyde“.

claims.statement: The karkadann is a mythical creature believed to inhabit the grassy plains of India and Iran.
claims.statement_id: Karkadann adalah makhluk mitos yang dipercaya hidup di padang rumput India dan Iran.
claims.quote: is a mythical creature said to have lived on the grassy plains of India and Iran.

claims.statement: Kargadan also means rhinoceros in Persian and Arabic.
claims.statement_id: Kargadan juga berarti badak dalam bahasa Persia dan Arab.
claims.quote: The word kargadan also means rhinoceros in Persian and Arabic.

claims.statement: Like the unicorn, the karkadann is believed to be subdued by virgins.
claims.statement_id: Seperti unicorn, karkadann dipercaya dapat dijinakkan oleh perawan.
claims.quote: Like the unicorn, it can be subdued by virgins

claims.statement: The karkadann’s depiction is initially based on the Indian rhinoceros.
claims.statement_id: Gambaran karkadann awalnya didasarkan pada badak India.
claims.quote: Originally based on the Indian rhinoceros

claims.statement: Al-Biruni provides an early description of the karkadann in the tenth to eleventh century.
claims.statement_id: Al-Biruni memberikan salah satu uraian awal karkadann pada abad kesepuluh hingga kesebelas.
claims.quote: An early description of the karkadann comes from the 10/11th century Persian scholar Al-Biruni (973–1048).

claims.statement: The karkadann’s horn is believed to have healing powers.
claims.statement_id: Tanduk karkadann dipercaya memiliki daya penyembuhan.
claims.quote: Its horn was said to have healing powers.

claims.statement: Udug are an ambiguously defined class of demons in Mesopotamian mythology.
claims.statement_id: Udug adalah golongan iblis yang identitas dan sifatnya ambigu dalam mitologi Mesopotamia.
claims.quote: adalah golongan iblis yang ambigu dari mitologi Mesopotamia kuno

claims.statement: In Akkadian, udug later becomes known as utukku.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Akkadia, udug kemudian disebut utukku.
claims.quote: yang kelak dikenal dalam Akkadia sebagai utukku

claims.statement: Udug are described as born in the underworld Kur.
claims.statement_id: Udug dikatakan lahir di dunia bawah Kur.
claims.quote: Mereka lahir di dunia bawah (Kur)

claims.statement: The term udug originally does not specify good or evil.
claims.statement_id: Istilah udug mula-mula tidak menentukan sifat baik atau jahat.
claims.quote: Kata ini pada awalnya tidak mengisyaratkan apakah iblis yang dimaksud itu baik atau jahat.

claims.statement: Exorcism texts invoke good udug against evil udug.
claims.statement_id: Teks pengusiran memanggil udug baik untuk melawan udug jahat.
claims.quote: Teks-teks pengusiran setan kadang-kadang memanggil "udug yang baik" untuk melawan "udug jahat".

claims.statement: Udug can also serve as an umbrella term rather than one demon’s name.
claims.statement_id: Udug juga dapat menjadi istilah payung, bukan nama satu iblis.
claims.quote: Terkadang kata udug bahkan tidak merujuk pada iblis tertentu, melainkan berfungsi sebagai istilah payung

claims.statement: In one of the two Gudea cylinders, King Gudea of Lagash (ruled c. 2144–2124 BCE) asks a goddess to send a "good udug" to protect him and a lama to guide him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam salah satu dari dua silinder Gudea, Raja Gudea dari Lagash (memerintah sekitar 2144–2124 SM) meminta seorang dewi mengirim "udug yang baik" untuk melindunginya dan lama untuk membimbingnya.
claims.quote: In one of the two Gudea cylinders, King Gudea of Lagash (ruled c. 2144–2124 BCE) asks a goddess to send a "good udug" to protect him and a lama to guide him.

claims.statement: Surviving ancient Mesopotamian exorcism instructions frequently invoke the "good udug" to provide protection or other aid while the exorcism is performed.
claims.statement_id: Teks Mesopotamia kuno yang masih ada tentang tata cara pengusiran setan sering memanggil "udug yang baik" untuk memberi perlindungan atau bantuan lain selama pengusiran berlangsung.
claims.quote: Surviving ancient Mesopotamian texts giving instructions for performing exorcisms frequently invoke the "good udug" to provide protection or other aid as the exorcism is being performed.

claims.statement: The evil udug is often a vector for physical and mental illnesses.
claims.statement_id: Udug jahat sering menjadi perantara penyakit jasmani dan jiwa.
claims.quote: The evil udug is often a vector for physical and mental illnesses.

claims.statement: The udug-ḫul incantations emphasize the evil udug as the cause of sickness and focus primarily on driving it out to cure the illness.
claims.statement_id: Mantra udug-hul menekankan peran udug jahat sebagai penyebab sakit dan terutama berfokus pada upaya mengusirnya untuk menyembuhkan penyakit.
claims.quote: The udug-ḫul incantations emphasize the role of the evil udug as the cause of sickness and focus primarily on attempting to drive out the evil udug to cure the illness.

claims.statement: Konstantopoulos notes that "the udug is defined by what it is not: the demon is nameless and formless, even in its early appearances."
claims.statement_id: Konstantopoulos mencatat bahwa "udug didefinisikan oleh apa yang bukan dirinya: iblis itu tak bernama dan tak berbentuk, bahkan pada kemunculan awalnya."
claims.quote: Konstantopoulos notes that "the udug is defined by what it is not: the demon is nameless and formless, even in its early appearances."

claims.statement: A text from the Old Babylonian Period (c. 1830 – c. 1531 BCE) requests, "May the evil udug and the evil galla stand aside. May the good udug and good galla be present."
claims.statement_id: Sebuah teks dari Periode Babilonia Lama (sekitar 1830 – 1531 SM) memohon, "Semoga udug jahat dan galla jahat menyingkir. Semoga udug baik dan galla baik hadir."
claims.quote: A text from the Old Babylonian Period (c. 1830 – c. 1531 BCE) requests, "May the evil udug and the evil galla stand aside. May the good udug and good galla be present."

claims.statement: Descriptions of the udug ascribe to it features often given to other ancient Mesopotamian demons: a dark shadow, absence of light surrounding it, poison, and a deafening voice.
claims.statement_id: Deskripsi tentang udug mengaitkannya dengan ciri yang sering diberikan kepada iblis Mesopotamia lain: bayangan gelap, ketiadaan cahaya di sekitarnya, racun, dan suara yang memekakkan.
claims.quote: descriptions of it ascribe to it features often given to other ancient Mesopotamian demons: a dark shadow, absence of light surrounding it, poison, and a deafening voice.

claims.statement: The canon of exorcism of the evil udug is known as udug-ḫul, whose Akkadian expansion (utukkū lemnūtu) is in sixteen tablets.
claims.statement_id: Kanon pengusiran udug jahat dikenal sebagai udug-hul; perluasannya dalam bahasa Akkadia (utukkū lemnūtu) terdiri atas enam belas lempeng.
claims.quote: The canon of exorcism of the evil udug is known as udug-ḫul, the Akkadian expansion of which (known in Akkadian as utukkū lemnūtu) is in sixteen tablets.

claims.statement: Because the udug is capable of both good and ill, Graham Cunningham argues that "the term daimon seems preferable" over "demon", the term normally used for it.
claims.statement_id: Karena udug mampu berbuat baik maupun buruk, Graham Cunningham berpendapat bahwa "istilah daimon tampaknya lebih tepat" daripada "demon", istilah yang biasa dipakai untuknya.
claims.quote: On account of the udug's capacity for both good and ill, Graham Cunningham argues that "the term daimon seems preferable" over the term "demon", which is the one normally used to describe it.

claims.statement: F. A. M. Wiggerman has argued that images of Lama and the udug were frequently used to guard doorways.
claims.statement_id: F. A. M. Wiggerman berpendapat bahwa citra Lama dan udug sering dipakai untuk menjaga pintu masuk.
claims.quote: F. A. M. Wiggerman has argued that images of Lama and the udug were frequently used to guard doorways.

claims.statement: The udug (Sumerian: 𒌜) was later known in Akkadian as the utukku.
claims.statement_id: Udug (Sumeria: 𒌜) kemudian dikenal dalam bahasa Akkadia sebagai utukku.
claims.quote: The udug (Sumerian: 𒌜), later known in Akkadian as the utukku

claims.statement: One of the udug could be Hanbi.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu udug mungkin adalah Hanbi.
claims.quote: One of the udug could be Hanbi.

claims.statement: The tradition of Udug Hul incantations spans the entirety of ancient Mesopotamian history, among the earliest texts known written in Sumerian in the third millennium BCE and among the last Mesopotamian texts of late antiquity.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi mantra Udug Hul mencakup seluruh sejarah Mesopotamia kuno; mantra itu termasuk teks tertua berbahasa Sumeria dari milenium ketiga SM sekaligus teks Mesopotamia terakhir dari akhir zaman kuno.
claims.quote: The tradition of  Udug Hul incantations spans the entirety of ancient Mesopotamian history; they are among the earliest texts known written in Sumerian in the third millennium BCE, as well as among the last Mesopotamian texts of late antiquity

claims.statement: According to this study, the first evil spirit, utukku, was originally a spirit, spectre, or ghost.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kajian ini, roh jahat pertama, utukku, semula adalah roh, hantu, atau arwah.
claims.quote: The first evil spirit, utukku, was originally a spirit, spectre, or ghost

claims.statement: The study says the six chief classes of evil spirits are enumerated in a constantly recurring line of the incantations: Evil Spirit, evil Demon, evil Ghost, evil Devil, evil God, evil Fiend.
claims.statement_id: Kajian ini menyebut enam jenis utama roh jahat yang terus berulang dalam satu baris mantra: Roh Jahat, Iblis Jahat, Hantu Jahat, Setan Jahat, Dewa Jahat, dan Makhluk Jahat.
claims.quote: the six chief of these are enumerated in the constantly recurring line ... Evil Spirit, evil Demon, evil Ghost, evil Devil, evil God, evil Fiend

claims.statement: According to this study, in the Epic of Gilgamish the hero asks the god Nergal to restore his friend Ea-bani, and his prayer is answered: the god opens the earth and the utukku of Ea-bani rises up.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kajian ini, dalam Epos Gilgamish sang pahlawan meminta dewa Nergal mengembalikan sahabatnya Ea-bani, dan doanya dikabulkan: sang dewa membuka bumi dan utukku Ea-bani naik.
claims.quote: The story runs that the hero Gilgamish appeals to the god Nergal to restore his friend Ea-bani to him, and his prayer is answered, for the god opens the earth and the utukku of Ea-bani rises up

claims.statement: According to this study, the utukku was a ghost or spectre that lurked in the desert lying in wait for man.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kajian ini, utukku adalah hantu atau bayangan yang mengintai manusia di gurun.
claims.quote: it was a ghost or spectre that either lurked in the desert lying in wait for man

claims.statement: According to this study, the utukku might instead have its home in the mountains, sea, or graveyard.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kajian ini, utukku dapat pula bertempat di pegunungan, laut, atau pekuburan.
claims.quote: in the mountains, sea, or graveyard

claims.statement: According to this study, evil would befall the person on whom it merely cast its eye.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kajian ini, malapetaka menimpa orang yang hanya dipandang olehnya.
claims.quote: evil would befall him on whom it merely cast its eye

claims.statement: Asag, or Azag, is a monstrous demon in the poem Lugal-e.
claims.statement_id: Asag atau Azag adalah iblis monster dalam puisi Lugal-e.
claims.quote: Asag or Azag (Sumerian:𒀉𒉺 a₂-sag₃; Akkadian: asakku) is a monstrous demon.

claims.statement: In the poem, Asag’s power makes fish boil alive in rivers.
claims.statement_id: Kekuatan Asag dalam puisi membuat ikan mendidih hidup-hidup di sungai.
claims.quote: his power is so hideous that it makes fishes boil alive in the rivers.

claims.statement: Asag is identified as the offspring of An and Ki.
claims.statement_id: Asag disebut sebagai keturunan An dan Ki.
claims.quote: he is described as the offspring of the sky god An and the earth goddess Ki.

claims.statement: Asag is said to mate with the mountains to produce stone offspring.
claims.statement_id: Asag dikisahkan berpasangan dengan pegunungan untuk menghasilkan keturunan batu.
claims.quote: he mated with the kur (mountains) to produce a brood of "stone" offspring

claims.statement: Ninurta, or Ningirsu, defeats Asag with the speaking mace Sharur.
claims.statement_id: Ninurta atau Ningirsu mengalahkan Asag dengan gada berbicara Sharur.
claims.quote: He was vanquished by the heroic deity Ninurta (or Ningirsu), using Sharur, his enchanted talking mace

claims.statement: Another version names Adad, or Ishkur, as Asag’s conqueror.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut Adad atau Ishkur sebagai pengalah Asag.
claims.quote: In another version of the myth, the Asag is defeated by Adad (Iškur).

claims.statement: In Oxford’s Ninurta battle text, Asag leaps to the head of the battle.
claims.statement_id: Dalam teks Oxford tentang pertempuran Ninurta, Asag melompat ke depan pertempuran.
claims.quote: The Asag leapt up at the head of the battle.

claims.statement: Illuyanka, also called Illuyankas, is a serpent or dragon in Hittite mythology.
claims.statement_id: Illuyanka atau Illuyankas adalah ular atau naga dalam mitologi Het.
claims.quote: イルルヤンカシュ (Illuyankas) は、ヒッタイト神話に伝わる蛇または竜である。イルヤンカ (Illyanka, Illuyanka)、ルヤンカスとも表記される。名前の意味は「蛇」で、ハッティ語に由来していると考えられている。この名称は固有名詞ではないとされ、先住民言語起源説が通説だが、印欧語起源説もある。イルルヤンカシュの神話はハットゥシャ出土の粘土板に記載されている。

claims.statement: The Hittite text tells of Illuyankas defeating Tarhus after they leave Kiskilussa.
claims.statement_id: Teks Het mengisahkan Illuyankas mengalahkan Tarhus ketika keduanya keluar dari Kiskilussa.
claims.quote: When Tarhus and Illuyankas got out of the city of Kiskilussa, Illuyankas defeated Tarhus.

claims.statement: In the preparations against Illuyankas, Inaras meets the human Hupasiyas at Ziggaratta.
claims.statement_id: Dalam persiapan melawan Illuyankas, Inaras menemui manusia Hupasiyas di Ziggaratta.
claims.quote: Inaras went to the city of Ziggaratta. She met the human Hupasiyas.

claims.statement: Illuyankas and his sons arrive, eat, and drink until they are drunk.
claims.statement_id: Illuyankas dan anak-anaknya datang, makan dan minum sampai mabuk.
claims.quote: Then Illuyankas came up with his sons. They ate and drank. They drank all the containers and got drunk.

claims.statement: Hupasiyas ties Illuyankas with a rope.
claims.statement_id: Hupasiyas mengikat Illuyankas dengan tali.
claims.quote: He tied up Illuyankas with a rope.

claims.statement: Tarhus arrives and kills Illuyankas.
claims.statement_id: Tarhus datang lalu membunuh Illuyankas.
claims.quote: Tarhus came and he killed Illuyankas.

claims.statement: In the other version, Tarhus’s son brings back his father’s heart and eyes from Illuyankas’s family.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, putra Tarhus mengembalikan jantung dan mata ayahnya dari keluarga Illuyankas.
claims.quote: He brought back the heart of Tarhus and his eyes.

issues.message: Diusulkan dilewati: Artikel Kur sesuai Q629219 membahas dunia bawah Mesopotamia, yaitu tempat kosmologis yang juga disebut Irkalla, bukan makhluk tersendiri. Identitas tidak diganti dengan naga yang berbeda. Entri new ini dikecualikan menurut §12. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kur).

claims.statement: Mummu is a Mesopotamian deity whose name may derive from Akkadian for creative force.
claims.statement_id: Mummu adalah dewa Mesopotamia; namanya diperkirakan berasal dari kata Akkadia untuk daya kreatif.
claims.quote: was a Mesopotamian god. His name is presumed to be derived from the Akkadian word mummu, "creative force".

claims.statement: In the Enuma Elish, Mummu appears as Apsu’s servant.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Enuma Elish, Mummu tampil sebagai pelayan Apsu.
claims.quote: he is portrayed as a servant of Apsu

claims.statement: Mummu is defeated together with his master by Ea.
claims.statement_id: Mummu dikalahkan bersama tuannya oleh Ea.
claims.quote: defeated alongside his master by Ea.

claims.statement: Ritual texts treat Mummu as a primordial deity residing in the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Teks ritual memperlakukan Mummu sebagai dewa primordial yang tinggal di dunia bawah.
claims.quote: In ritual texts Mummu was treated as a primordial deity residing in the underworld

claims.statement: Mummu also occurs as an epithet of other deities.
claims.statement_id: Mummu juga tercatat sebagai gelar dewa-dewa lain.
claims.quote: the term mummu is also attested as an epithet of other deities

claims.statement: The accompanying source describes Mummu as a Babylonian god of craftsmen.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menyebut Mummu sebagai dewa perajin Babilonia.
claims.quote: MUMMU - The Babylonian god of craftsmen.

claims.statement: Aisha Qandicha is a female mythical figure in Moroccan folklore.
claims.statement_id: Aisha Qandicha adalah tokoh mitos perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Maroko.
claims.quote: is a female mythological figure in Moroccan folklore.

claims.statement: She is often depicted as a beautiful woman with hoofed legs like a goat or camel.
claims.statement_id: Ia sering digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik dengan kaki hewan berkuku seperti kambing atau unta.
claims.quote: she is typically depicted as a beautiful young woman who has the legs of a hoofed animal such as a goat or camel

claims.statement: She is believed to live near rivers, lakes, and the sea.
claims.statement_id: Ia dipercaya tinggal dekat sungai, danau, dan laut.
claims.quote: who lives near rivers, lakes and the sea

claims.statement: Aisha Qandicha is associated with the Hamadsha and Zar societies.
claims.statement_id: Aisha Qandicha dihubungkan dengan kelompok Hamadsha dan Zar.
claims.quote: Aisha Qandicha is associated with the Hamadsha and Zār societies

claims.statement: The local beliefs discussed describe her as fearing steel knives and needles.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan lokal yang dibahas menyebutnya takut pada pisau baja dan jarum.
claims.quote: she is afraid of steel knives and needles

claims.statement: Those beliefs name Hammu Qayyu as her husband or male associate.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan itu menyebut Hammu Qayyu sebagai suami atau rekan laki-lakinya.
claims.quote: has a husband (or male associate) known as Hammu Qayyu.

claims.statement: The text records that among the Arabic-speaking people of Northern Morocco there is a belief in this female spirit.
claims.statement_id: Teks ini mencatat bahwa di kalangan penutur bahasa Arab di Maroko utara ada kepercayaan kepada perempuan gaib ini.
claims.quote: Among the Arabic-speaking people of Northern Morocco there is a belief in

claims.statement: Besides appearing as a grown woman, she has also been seen with the legs of a goat or an ass, or with a woman's legs and the body of a she-goat with long pendant breasts.
claims.statement_id: Selain tampil sebagai perempuan dewasa, ia juga pernah terlihat berkaki kambing atau keledai, atau berkaki perempuan dengan tubuh kambing betina berpayudara panjang menggantung.
claims.quote: but she has also been seen with the legs of a goat or an ass, or with the legs of a woman and the body of a she-goat with long pendant breasts.

claims.statement: She is described as very libidinous and tries to seduce handsome young men.
claims.statement_id: Ia disebut sangat bernafsu dan berusaha merayu pemuda tampan.
claims.quote: She is very libidinous and tries to seduce handsome young men.

claims.statement: According to the account, the man who goes with her will be maddened by her.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah itu, orang yang mau pergi bersamanya akan dibuat gila olehnya.
claims.quote: and that he who does so will be maddened by her.

claims.statement: Her home, according to the text, is in a river or a spring or the sea.
claims.statement_id: Rumahnya, menurut teks ini, berada di sungai, mata air, atau laut.
claims.quote: She has her home, however, in a river or a spring or the sea.

claims.statement: According to the text, she seizes and kills persons who bathe there; every year three or four men fall victims to her in this way.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks ini, ia menangkap dan membunuh orang yang mandi di sungai itu; setiap tahun tiga atau empat orang menjadi korbannya.
claims.quote: she seizes and kills persons who bathe there—indeed, every year three or four men fall victims to her in this way.

claims.statement: In one city she is said to appear in the shape of an ugly old woman with pendant breasts.
claims.statement_id: Di salah satu kota, ia disebut muncul dalam wujud perempuan tua buruk rupa berpayudara menggantung.
claims.quote: in the shape of an ugly old woman with pendant breasts.

claims.statement: Among the tribe named in the text, she has the vicious habit of approaching married men in the shapes of their wives and then taking their lives.
claims.statement_id: Di antara suku yang disebut dalam teks ini, ia berkebiasaan buruk mendekati lelaki beristri dalam wujud istri mereka lalu mencabut nyawanya.
claims.quote: has the vicious habit of approaching married men in the shapes of their wives and then taking their lives.

claims.statement: According to the text, she is afraid of things of steel, even needles.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks ini, ia takut pada benda-benda baja, bahkan jarum.
claims.quote: is afraid of things of steel, even needles

claims.statement: In that tribe, those who swim in the river on Midsummer day customarily first throw burning straw into it as an offering to her and her husband.
claims.statement_id: Dalam suku itu, orang yang berenang di sungai pada hari Midsummer biasa lebih dulu melemparkan jerami terbakar ke sungai sebagai persembahan bagi Aisha Qandicha dan suaminya.

claims.statement: Az-Zukhruf 43:36 assigns a devil as companion to someone ignoring remembrance of the All-beneficent; interpretations of that companion differ.
claims.statement_id: Terjemahan Az-Zukhruf 43:36 menyebut setan sebagai pendamping orang yang mengabaikan peringatan Yang Maha Pengasih, sementara bentuk pendamping itu dibahas berbeda oleh penafsir.
claims.quote: We assign a devil to be the companion of him who turns a blind eye to the remembrance of the All-beneficent.

claims.statement: Rakhsh is Rostam’s horse in the Persian epic Shahnameh, or Book of Kings.
claims.statement_id: Rakhsh adalah kuda pahlawan Persia Rostam dalam Shahnameh atau Buku Para Raja.
claims.quote: est le cheval du héros mythique perse Rostam, tel qu'il est décrit dans l'épopée nationale iranienne Livre des Rois.

claims.statement: Rostam chooses Rakhsh for its strength and courage.
claims.statement_id: Rostam memilih Rakhsh karena kekuatan dan keberaniannya.
claims.quote: Rostam choisit le cheval Rakhch connu pour sa grande force et son courage.

claims.statement: Rakhsh allows only Rostam to ride it.
claims.statement_id: Rakhsh hanya mengizinkan Rostam menungganginya.
claims.quote: Rakhch ne laisse que Rostam le monter

claims.statement: Rakhsh wakes Rostam three times to warn that a dragon approaches.
claims.statement_id: Rakhsh membangunkan Rostam tiga kali untuk memperingatkan kedatangan naga.
claims.quote: Rakhsh réveille à trois reprises Rostam pour le prévenir qu'un dragon approche.

claims.statement: In Shaghad’s trap, Rakhsh is killed by impalement and Rostam is mortally wounded.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perangkap Shaghad, Rakhsh mati tertusuk dan Rostam terluka parah hingga menjelang kematian.
claims.quote: Rakhch est transpercé et tué sur le coup. Rostam est blessé à mort.

claims.statement: The accompanying source portrays Rakhsh as Rustum’s stallion with exceptional power and intelligence.
claims.statement_id: Sumber pendamping menggambarkan Rakhsh sebagai kuda jantan Rustum dengan kekuatan dan kecerdasan luar biasa.
claims.quote: Rakhsh – the great stallion of the hero Rustum, mightier and more intelligent than any other horse

claims.statement: Ullikummi is a giant stone monster and Kumarbi’s son in Hurrian mythology.
claims.statement_id: Ullikummi adalah monster batu raksasa, putra Kumarbi, dalam mitologi Hurri.
claims.quote: Ullikummi is a giant stone monster, son of Kumarbi

claims.statement: Cuneiform texts found at Bogazkoy preserve fragments of the Song of Ullikummi.
claims.statement_id: Naskah paku yang ditemukan di Bogazkoy memuat fragmen Kisah Ullikummi.
claims.quote: cuneiform texts recovered at Bogaskoy, where some Hurrian fragments of the Song of Ullikummi have been found.

claims.statement: Ullikummi is portrayed as genderless, deaf, blind, and sentient.
claims.statement_id: Ullikummi digambarkan tidak berjenis kelamin, tuli, buta, tetapi memiliki kesadaran.
claims.quote: a genderless, deaf, blind, yet sentient volcanic rock monster, Ullikummi

claims.statement: Ullikummi is placed on Upelluri’s shoulder without Upelluri sensing it.
claims.statement_id: Ullikummi diletakkan di bahu Upelluri yang tidak merasakan keberadaannya.
claims.quote: placed on the shoulder of Upelluri. Upelluri, absorbed in his meditations, did not feel Ullikummi on his shoulder.

claims.statement: Ullikummi quickly grows to reach the heavens.
claims.statement_id: Ullikummi tumbuh cepat hingga mencapai langit.
claims.quote: Ullikummi grew quickly until he reached the heavens.

claims.statement: Ea visits Upelluri and cuts Ullikummi’s feet, causing him to fall.
claims.statement_id: Ea mendatangi Upelluri dan memotong kaki Ullikummi sehingga ia jatuh.
claims.quote: Ea visited Upelluri and cut off the feet of Ullikummi, toppling him

claims.statement: In Dickson’s summary, Ea advises giving Teshub the ancient copper knife that separated heaven and earth to confront Ullikummi.
claims.statement_id: Dalam ringkasan Dickson, Ea menyarankan Teshub menggunakan pisau tembaga purba pemisah langit dan bumi untuk menghadapi Ullikummi.
claims.quote: Teshub be given the ancient copper knife originally used to split heaven and earth apart at the beginning of time.

claims.statement: Dickson’s summary has Teshub cut Ullukummi away from Ubelluri and defeat him, whereas the article attributes the cutting to Ea.
claims.statement_id: Ringkasan Dickson menyebut Teshub memisahkan Ullukummi dari Ubelluri dan mengalahkannya, berbeda dari atribusi pemotongan kepada Ea dalam artikel.
claims.quote: Teshub splits Ullukummi from Ubelluri and defeats him

claims.statement: Azhdaha is a mythical Iranian creature comparable to a dragon.
claims.statement_id: Azhdaha adalah makhluk mitos Iran yang sepadan dengan naga.
claims.quote: is a mythical creature in Iranian mythology, roughly equivalent to the dragon.

claims.statement: Persian literature depicts azhdaha as giant winged serpents inhabiting air, sea, or land.
claims.statement_id: Sastra Persia menggambarkan azhdaha sebagai ular raksasa bersayap di udara, laut, atau darat.
claims.quote: In Persian literature, they are depicted as gigantic, winged serpents that live in the air, in the sea, or on the earth.

claims.statement: Azhdaha is depicted with a huge body, fierce face, bright eyes, and a wide mouth with many teeth.
claims.statement_id: Azhdaha digambarkan bertubuh besar, bermuka garang, bermata terang, dan bermulut lebar dengan banyak gigi.
claims.quote: azhdaha have huge bodies, fierce faces, bright eyes, and wide mouths with many teeth.

claims.statement: The article places early written references to azhdaha in the Avestan period.
claims.statement_id: Artikel menempatkan rujukan tertulis awal azhdaha pada periode Avesta.
claims.quote: early written references recorded in the Avestan period.

claims.statement: In the Shahnameh, heroes including Sam, Rostam, Esfandiar, and Bahram V slay azhdaha.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Shahnameh, azhdaha dibunuh pahlawan seperti Sam, Rostam, Esfandiar, dan Bahram V.
claims.quote: they are slain by heroes such as Sām, Rostam, Esfandiar, Bahram V (Gur).

claims.statement: In the Islamic accounts discussed, azhdaha begins as an ordinary snake that grows large and destructive.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Islam yang dibahas, azhdaha bermula sebagai ular biasa yang menjadi besar dan merusak.
claims.quote: In Islamic accounts, the azhdaha was a mundane snake that had grown large and destructive

claims.statement: Iranica links some azhdaha with natural phenomena, particularly rain and eclipses.
claims.statement_id: Iranica menghubungkan sebagian azhdaha dengan gejala alam, terutama hujan dan gerhana.
claims.quote: sometimes connected with natural phenomena, especially rain and eclipses.

claims.statement: Lilin are night spirits in Jewish mythology, described as Lilith’s male counterparts.
claims.statement_id: Lilin adalah roh-roh malam dalam mitologi Yahudi, padanan laki-laki Lilith.
claims.quote: are plural night spirits in Jewish mythology, male equivalent of Lilith

claims.statement: The article places lilin’s first appearance in 2 Baruch as demons similar to shedim.
claims.statement_id: Artikel menempatkan kemunculan awal lilin dalam 2 Baruch, sebagai iblis yang mirip shedim.
claims.quote: Their first appearance is in 2 Baruch, as demons similar to shedim

claims.statement: Lilin appears in rabbinic literature including the Babylonian Talmud and Midrash.
claims.statement_id: Lilin muncul dalam sastra rabinik seperti Talmud Babilonia dan Midrash.
claims.quote: in rabbinic literature such as the Babylonian Talmud and Midrash.

claims.statement: Lilin is believed to derive from Akkadian lilu.
claims.statement_id: Lilin dipercaya berkaitan dengan lilû dalam bahasa Akkadia.
claims.quote: The lilin are believed to be derived from the Akkadian lilû

claims.statement: Lilin is depicted with a human form and wings.
claims.statement_id: Lilin digambarkan dalam bentuk manusia dengan sayap.
claims.quote: They have human form with an addition of wings

claims.statement: The article links masculine lilin to hundreds of Sasanian-era Aramaic incantation bowls also naming Bagdana and Lilith.
claims.statement_id: Artikel menghubungkan lilin laki-laki dengan ratusan mangkuk mantra Aram era Sasaniyah yang juga menyebut Bagdana dan Lilith.
claims.quote: Hundreds of Aramaic incantation bowls from Sasanian Empire survive, that mention Bagdana "king of the liliths", Lilith, female liliths, and their masculine counterparts, lilis (lylyn) or male liliths.

claims.statement: Charles’s translation of 2 Baruch 10:8 calls Lilin from the desert to join a lament.
claims.statement_id: Terjemahan Charles atas 2 Baruch 10:8 memanggil lilin dari padang gurun untuk bergabung dalam ratapan.
claims.quote: And you Lilin, come you from the desert
